title: CI repair keeps authorization fixtures honest and parser cost bounded
summary: Classify overlapping CI failures by root cause, reproduce the CI identity, preserve security oracles and distinguish bounded local verification from full remote results.
procedure_steps: Collect every original CI result before a consolidated update. Role-bound store fixtures must copy canonical security and agent policies and bind legitimate personas; absent policy must remain denied. Negative tests should assert the first stronger policy diagnostic and retain independent roleless bootstrap controls. Tenant-bound organization discovery scans only its own protected partition instead of enumerating the tier root. Split independent expensive real-store and rate-limit scenarios while preserving all snapshot, identity, privacy, lease and side-effect assertions. Placeholder scanning must preserve the exact token grammar while walking unmatched delimiters linearly. Metadata-only credential lookup hashes require evidence and explicit owner approval for an external false-positive disposition, not a breaking storage-key change. An interrupted full-suite run is never final green evidence; report focused build/gate results and remote CI separately.
safety_notes: Require approval before irreversible or high-risk actions.
Capture evidence before and after the action.
escalation_conditions: Result does not match the expected state
